arch.texto: Built in the 1970s, the house follows the Mediterranean approach that reached Búzios through Greek architecture: a run of round arches, white rendered walls and ceramic roof tiles. It is the design that answers the climate and the view at once, at the most privileged address on the peninsula.

location.title: Our Location
location.intro: In the heart of Búzios, between Orla Bardot and Rua das Pedras, Casa Humaitá sits a few minutes from the most beautiful beaches on the peninsula. Tap the points on the map or drag to see our places.

items.name: Alenka
items.text: We loved this house. The view is simply breathtaking and it is, without a doubt, the best part of the property. The house is very well equipped and is perfect for a large family or a group of friends.

items.name: Joan
items.text: Casa Humaitá is a wonderful experience, not only for its magnificent view and its wonderful space, but above all for Paulo, who is always available.

items.name: Jezreel
items.text: This place was absolutely exceptional, the photos do not do it justice. The views are immaculate and the location is fantastic, just a five-minute walk from the whole main street.

items.name: Verna
items.text: Wonderful house, much better than in the photos, it has everything you need for a comfortable stay. Beautiful decor, impeccable bed and bath linen, spacious bedrooms with a lovely view.

items.name: Mauro
items.text: An incredibly beautiful house. The view and the decor are a dream. It has everything you need. We were very happy there.

items.name: Erich
items.text: Stunning view. Comfortable bedrooms. Plenty of space. Excellent host, discreet and kind.

items.name: Micaela
items.text: A house with an incredible view. A highly recommended place to rest. We will be back.

items.name: David
items.text: The place was beautiful, with incredible views and a great location, really within reach of many restaurants and places a short walk away.

items.name: Jessica Franzoni
items.text: The most charming house I have ever stayed in. It has one of the most beautiful views in Búzios, well worth it. Wonderful location, you can walk to Orla Bardot.

items.name: Loreto
items.text: Everything was wonderful and the house was incredible, great location.
